reason: Jamku charges only ₹6,500 a year, so asking ₹12,990 upfront for a two-person firm feels twice as expensive as it should be. While the Trainee Laptop Shield directly targets my anxiety about article clerks leaving with client data on personal laptops, as a frugal buyer I will stick to testing the two-seat free pilot before ever paying that premium.
objection: Jamku charges only ₹6,500 a year—why is Docketra more expensive, and does the Trainee Laptop Shield truly prevent article clerks from copying or leaking client files?
would_change_my_mind: A starter tier priced closer to Jamku around ₹6,500 to ₹8,000 a year, alongside verified proof on the free pilot that trainees cannot extract client files to personal machines.
